title: Stanford violated its AI policy by turning a Hispanic student into a fake Black woman in ad

reading.body:
This is a synthetic image presented as a documentary photograph of real people. A student who was in the original picture was removed and replaced with a generated person, and the remaining students were altered in appearance. The banner showed a scene that never happened, and nothing on the banner told viewers that.

The failure happened in the production of public-facing marketing material, after the original photograph existed and before the banners went up. Stanford had a written policy that banned exactly this use of AI on images of its people, and the policy was not applied at the point where the artwork was approved. Catching it would have taken a review step that compared the finished image against the source photograph and checked it against that policy, which is the kind of review the university now says it will add.

What is not established is who performed the alteration, whether it was intended, and whether anyone faced consequences for it. The university confirmed the edit and called it a violation of its own policy, and that confirmation is not a finding about motive.

reports.title: Stanford Used A.I. to Swap Black Student for Hispanic Student in a Photo
Stanford R&DE Uses AI to Race Swap Students for Advertising
University confirms use of AI-edited photo amid controversy
Stanford violated its AI policy by turning a Hispanic student into a fake Black woman in ad

summary:
Billy Ramirez, a Hispanic senior majoring in human biology at Stanford, appeared in a 2024 Lunar New Year photo with two other students. Stanford’s dining service posted it online the next day. When Stanford used the image on campus banners last week, Ramirez had been replaced by a Black woman, and the other students were made to look thinner. Ramirez learned about it from a friend and said he was upset and frustrated.

Stanford said on Tuesday that it had used artificial intelligence to alter the original image. The university said its policy strictly bans using AI to produce or change images of Stanford people, events, research, facilities, or achievements, and that both the alteration and the lack of disclosure broke that policy. Stanford said it is working with Residential and Dining Enterprises to add training and make sure all materials are properly reviewed.
title_en: Stanford violated its AI policy by turning a Hispanic student into a fake Black woman in ad
